text: The glass walls and pristine emptiness evoke a sense of anticipation, almost as if I am on the verge of entering a space where something significant is about to happen, yet silence prevails. Moving into the next scene, surrounded by the colors and symbols of research and development, I sense a spark of intellectual curiosity. The celebration of innovation on the wall inspires me to reflect on humanity’s restless urge to understand and shape the world. Here, the future and past seem to whisper to each other through technology and text. I feel both grounded by the physical space and uplifted by the ideas on display.
